verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents its own server-side automation features. Filters & Rules sort mail automatically, Scheduled Send sends at a set time, and Snooze returns a message to the Inbox later, all without the user present. The evidence is mostly article titles, though, with no detail on trigger types, actions, or any agentic/AI-driven automation. The JMAP API and push are developer building blocks, not a built-in automation feature, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented rule triggers and actions in depth, AI/agent-driven or multi-step workflow automation, and independent hands-on corroboration of background automation.
